name: Long-Range RFID Skimming
description: In the active engagement phase, the same weaponized reader hardware deployed during recon is used to harvest credentials from employees in the target environment — lobbies, parking garages, elevators — for immediate replay. The operator carries the concealed reader in a bag or backpack and moves through high-traffic areas to collect credentials without any interaction. See PRTF-1.11 for the recon-phase application of this technique.

blue.det: Individual with unusual equipment near entry points; reader logs showing credential read without badge presentation; OSDP tamper alert.
blue.cm: OSDP encrypted readers prevent Wiegand-based skimming; anti-skimming reader covers; monitor for credential reads without associated door event; relocate readers from exterior walls.
